scripts.check:foundation: tsc src/lib/*.ts --outDir .check-build --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck && node scripts/check-foundation.mjs ./.check-build
scripts.check:platform: tsc src/services/*.ts --outDir .check-platform --module commonjs --target es2022 --lib es2022,dom --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck --strict && node scripts/check-platform.mjs ./.check-platform
